prompts.prompt: Create ONE original production-ready pixel-art game sprite: a compact TWO-STORY FUTURISTIC ROW HOUSE for Viltrum's modern ecumenopolis. This is an individual reusable building asset, not a city illustration. Genuine transparent alpha background, isolated building, NO floor/base/platform/grass/ground shadow/background/checkerboard. Orthographic RPG top-down three-quarter view facing the SOUTH FRONT facade: front edge perfectly horizontal, sides vertical, roof visible above front facade, no isometric rotation or diamond. Rectangular width-to-height ratio about 5:6, fill the frame with a clean complete uncut silhouette. One readable central ground-floor front door, broad teal glass windows, ivory pale stone/metal structural panels, deep slate blue shadow planes, a low flat rooftop with simple parapet and a compact teal skylight. Ordinary welcoming attached townhouse proportions, not a skinny skyscraper, not a medieval house. Tight straight side walls so identical houses can align directly next to one another. Rich but clean professional 32px-grid RPG pixel art, coherent bold clusters, restrained cyan details, clean dark outlines, light from upper left. Designed to be converted to 160x192 pixels: door must read at roughly 24x36 final pixels, windows broad and legible; avoid tiny texture noise. No text, labels, logos, numbers, floating props, decorations outside footprint, no multiple views. Architectural material inspiration: Viltrum's white futuristic towers and teal glass, translated to human-scale modern residential street frontage. Return a single south-facing building on transparent background.

Make a complementary attached TWO-STORY ROW HOUSE variant of this building. Same compact proportions, width5 x height6tiles, final160x192px. Straight vertical side boundaries let neighboring houses touch. Not isometric. The sprite will be used next to this building on a 32px BYOND tile grid. No text or lettering.
